data.title: 夜刀神十香 · 海边的黄豆粉冰饮
data.description: 十香穿着紫色系泳装，双手抱住比脸还大的黄豆粉冰饮，坐在栈桥边让脚尖拍打海水；一阵海风吹来，她的蝴蝶结和长发同时飞起，兴奋地望着远处的浪花。
data.location: sunlit wooden pier at a quiet resort beach
data.action: 坐在栈桥边，双手抱住巨大冰饮，双脚轻拍海水，长发与蝴蝶结随海风扬起
data.lighting: bright noon light and blue water reflections
data.mood: 发现人类假日的新鲜快乐
data.promptProse: Seated on the pier's edge, Tohka holds her oversized soybean drink in both hands while her feet stir the sunlit shallows.
data.animaCaption: Both hands hold the oversized soybean drink as her feet stir the shallows below the pier.
